set.body:
Scope: surface-view, surface-view-raster, shared scene/readback/picking contracts and Intaglio adapters.

Deliverable: Move surface scenes, decorations, CPU reference rendering and raster backend to optional neurosurf4s display modules with tests/assets.

Acceptance:
- Independent scalar surface -> scene -> image/pick/readback examples run with no ScalaFIM dependency.
- CPU reference images, visibility/picking and persisted scene/profile compatibility checks pass on supported platforms.
- Existing wire tags remain stable, reusable graphics remain Intaglio-owned and no JVM UI dependency enters shared core.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U5: Move renderer-neutral surface scenes and CPU raster display
